title: On the Approximation and Convergence of Distributional Policy Gradient Algorithms for Risk-Sensitive Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2405.14749v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Risk-sensitive reinforcement learning (RL) is crucial for maintaining reliable performance in high-stakes applications. While traditional RL methods aim to learn a point estimate of the random cumulative cost, distributional RL seeks to estimate the entire distribution of it, leading to a unified framework for handling different risk measures. However, developing policy gradient methods for risk-sensitive distributional RL is inherently more complex as it often involves finding the gradient of a probability measure. This paper introduces a new distributional policy gradient framework for risk-sensitive RL, where we derive an analytical gradient of the probability measure of the cumulative cost. For practical implementation, we further design a categorical distributional policy gradient algorithm (CDPG) that approximates arbitrary distributions using a categorical family supported on fixed points. Using Conditional Value-at-Risk

translated_title: 关于风险敏感强化学习中分布式策略梯度算法的逼近与收敛性研究
translated_abstract: 风险敏感强化学习（RL）对于在高风险应用中保持可靠性能至关重要。传统RL方法旨在学习随机累积成本的点估计，而分布式RL则寻求估计其整个分布，从而为处理不同风险度量提供了统一的框架。然而，为风险敏感分布式RL开发策略梯度方法本质上更为复杂，因为它通常涉及求概率测度的梯度。本文为风险敏感RL引入了一种新的分布式策略梯度框架，其中我们推导了累积成本概率测度的解析梯度。为了实际实现，我们进一步设计了一种分类分布式策略梯度算法（CDPG），该算法使用支撑在固定点上的分类分布族来逼近任意分布。利用条件风险价值（CVaR）……
tldr: 本文为风险敏感强化学习提出了一种新的分布式策略梯度框架，推导了累积成本概率测度的解析梯度，并设计了基于分类分布逼近的CDPG算法及其逼近与收敛性保证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a new distributional policy gradient framework for risk-sensitive reinforcement learning, derives an analytical gradient of the probability measure of cumulative cost, and designs a categorical distributional policy gradient algorithm (CDPG) with approximation and convergence guarantees.
